This script downloads all basemap grids within the Circumpolar South region for a specific year.

# Set-Up
## Load Packages

```{python}
import os
import sys
from google.cloud import storage
import google.auth
import pandas as pd
from pprint import pprint
import ast
import re
```

## API Keys
```{python}
# Get Planet API Key
%load_ext dotenv
%dotenv

```

## Google Cloud Set-Up

```{python}
# ! gcloud auth login
gcloud_creds, _ =google.auth.default()
```

```{python}
project_name = "abruptthawmapping"
storage_client = storage.Client(project=project_name)
bucket_name = "abrupt_thaw"
bucket = storage_client.bucket(bucket_name)
```

# Define Functions
This needs to be updated to just remove the order_id directory within the delivery directory.
```{python}
def rename_to_flat_folder_structure(old_path, base_path):
    file_name = old_path.split(sep="/")[-1]
    new_path = base_path + "/" + file_name

    return new_path
```

# Find Image Filepaths
## Train/Val/Test Split

```{python}
blobs = bucket.list_blobs(prefix="planet_basemaps/global_quarterly/2025/q3")
blobs = [blob for blob in blobs]

files = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "blob": [blob for blob in blobs if re.search("quad.*tif$", blob.name)],
        "filepath": [blob.name for blob in blobs if re.search("quad.*tif$", blob.name)]
    }
)
```


```{python}
files["download_location"] = [
    rename_to_flat_folder_structure(
        file,
        "/mnt/0AA6E441A6E42F3F/Users/Heidi Rodenhizer/Documents/ArcGIS/Projects/ARTSManualEditing/test_set_2025/imagery",
    )
    for file in files.filepath
]
```

```{python}
for blob, download_location in zip(files.blob, files.download_location):
    if not os.path.exists(download_location):
        print(f"Downloading {blob.name} -> {download_location}")
        blob.download_to_filename(download_location)
```
